package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"testing"
)

type revisionStub struct {
	revision domain.LessonRevision
	calls    int
}

func (s *revisionStub) ResolveLessonRevision(_ context.Context, lesson, revision string) (domain.LessonRevision, error) {
	s.calls++
	if lesson != s.revision.LessonID {
		return domain.LessonRevision{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if revision != "" && revision != s.revision.ID {
		return domain.LessonRevision{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return s.revision, nil
}
func TestFreezeLessonAssignmentsIndependentAndImmutable(t *testing.T) {
	lesson := uuid.NewString()
	source := &revisionStub{revision: domain.LessonRevision{Schema: "lesson-revision.v1", ID: uuid.NewString(), LessonID: lesson, Content: json.RawMessage(`{"title":"R10","tasks":[]}`), Activities: []domain.LessonRevisionActivity{{ID: uuid.NewString(), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: lesson}}}}}
	items := []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: lesson, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first"}, {ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: lesson, Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "second"}}
	frozen, err := freezeLessonItems(context.Background(), source, items, "request", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if frozen[0].ID == frozen[1].ID || frozen[0].FrozenRequirements[0].ID == frozen[1].FrozenRequirements[0].ID {
		t.Fatal("executions share identity")
	}
	replay, err := freezeLessonItems(context.Background(), source, items, "request", nil)
	if err != nil || replay[0].ID != frozen[0].ID {
		t.Fatal("allocation nondeterministic")
	}
	oldRevision := frozen[0].LessonRevisionID
	source.revision.ID = uuid.NewString()
	source.revision.Content = json.RawMessage(`{"title":"R11","tasks":[]}`)
	calls := source.calls
	preserved, err := freezeLessonItems(context.Background(), source, frozen, "replan", frozen)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if source.calls != calls || preserved[0].LessonRevisionID != oldRevision || string(preserved[0].LessonContent) != `{"title":"R10","tasks":[]}` {
		t.Fatal("new publication mutated existing semantics")
	}
	frozen[0].LessonRevisionID = source.revision.ID
	if _, err = freezeLessonItems(context.Background(), source, frozen, "drift", preserved); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("revision drift accepted")
	}
}
func TestFreezeLegacyCutoverKeepsUnboundSemantics(t *testing.T) {
	legacy := domain.LearningPathItem{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemCompleted, ReasonCode: "legacy"}
	source := &revisionStub{}
	desired := legacy
	desired.ID = ""
	result, err := freezeLessonItems(context.Background(), source, []domain.LearningPathItem{desired}, "replan", []domain.LearningPathItem{legacy})
	if err != nil || source.calls != 0 || result[0].LessonRevisionID != "" || len(result[0].FrozenRequirements) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("legacy inferred semantics")
	}
}
